verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching a machine-readable spec is the probe's note that, one day earlier, taxonomy and download bundles were fetched without credentials from the ERiC developer host (esteuer.de). On 2026-10-07 that host timed out on a single GET with no retry, so current availability is unconfirmed. No first-party documentation in the pack describes published XML schemas, an OpenAPI spec, or a data dictionary. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the published schemas/data dictionary, confirmed current keyless access to the artifacts, detail on spec format and coverage of the ERiC channel
